newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobile phones in France up 10 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Mobile phones in France up 10 pct in December.

text.p: The number of mobile telephones in France increased in December by 224,300, or 10 percent, to 2.46 million, telecoms regulator ART said on Thursday.
It said subscriptions rose 11.5 percent for digital phones to 2.25 million, but fell 3.2 percent for analog to 212,200.

The Itineris service of France Telecom posted a 9.6 percent rise in December to 1.33 million subscribers. SFR, part of Generale des Eaux, showed a 13.2 percent rise to 809,700, and Bouygues Telecom's business increased by 25 percent to 90,200.
Digital phone business grew 54 percent during the second half of 1996.
Itineris's growth in that period was 42 percent, 62 percent for SFR, and 616 percent for Bouyques, the latest entrant in the market.
